description: A Web API sends data to other programs. ASP.NET Core controllers group the request actions into C# classes. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. Install the .NET SDK. Run dotnet new web -n SchoolApi and enter it. Replace Program.cs with one example. Run dotnet run --urls http://127.0.0.1:8000. These examples use controllers without a database.
versionNote: These lessons use modern ASP.NET Core controller APIs on .NET 8 or later, not the older System.Web API.
whatYouWillLearn: Make a controller action with ASP.NET Web API
Read a query input with ASP.NET Web API
Return a new item location with ASP.NET Web API
Set a controller response header with ASP.NET Web API
learningObjectives: Make a controller action with ASP.NET Web API
Read a typed body with ASP.NET Web API
Return a typed collection with ASP.NET Web API
